items.statement: Each named migratory-insertion candidate is subjected to vibrational analysis and a transition-state assignment requires one imaginary mode corresponding to the expected bond-making/bond-breaking motion.
items.expected: The submission reports per-label imaginary-frequency counts, eigenvector/chemical assignment evidence, and a validated or explicitly failed status for TS3A-quartet, TS3B-quartet, TS3C-quartet, and TS3D-quartet.

items.statement: Local insertion barriers use INT2A-quartet for TS3A/B and INT2B-quartet for TS3C/D, with consistent thermal and solvation terms; separated-reference profile heights are distinct.
items.expected: The submission states G(TS3A/B)−G(INT2A-quartet) and G(TS3C/D)−G(INT2B-quartet), or explicitly transforms an alternative reference using calculated coordination free energies; otherwise reports bounded failure.

items.statement: The four quartet migratory-insertion pathways have a concrete relative free-energy barrier comparison.
items.expected: A complete comparison reports barriers for all four named labels in kcal/mol, with provenance and a stated computational convention.

items.statement: The reported quartet barrier trend is TS3A-quartet lower than TS3D-quartet, TS3B-quartet, and TS3C-quartet.
items.expected: The submitted ordering is TS3A-quartet < TS3D-quartet < TS3B-quartet < TS3C-quartet when all four candidates are validated.
